datasets.title: Retinal Image Dataset of Infants and ROP
datasets.labels: ICROP stage 0-3, AP-ROP, treated (st.p. ROP), 4 non-ROP diagnoses; plus-form; 3 cameras
datasets.role: TRAINING - this is what the shipped model was built on
datasets.note: Symlink to ../../dataset_split (the prepared split). PRIVATE infant photographs. Stage labels are recoverable only by joining docs/infant_retinal_database_info.csv on (ID, serie, device). 43% of its 'ROP-positive' class is NOT ROP.
datasets.caveat: Image resolution is a perfect 1:1 proxy for camera, and camera carries most of the label signal: dimensions alone score AUC 0.911 on its test split.

datasets.title: ROP-VL
datasets.labels: 8 classes: normal, Stage 1-5, A-ROP, laser-treated. Per-infant GA, birth weight, plurality, delivery mode. Per-class clinical text (vision-language).
datasets.role: THE key acquisition - only public source of Stage 4 and Stage 5 anywhere
datasets.note: Overlaps Shenzhen by only ~1-2% of images (20-22 shared photographs) despite the same hospital and 6 shared authors. Where they overlap ROP-VL holds the higher-resolution original. No zone axis, no plus axis.
datasets.caveat: Filenames embed exam dates at day granularity - a date-of-service identifier. Do not propagate those filenames into anything public.

datasets.title: FARFUM-RoP
datasets.labels: Retinopathy grade + ICROP stage, recorded INDEPENDENTLY by five paediatric ophthalmologists (A-E), plus per-patient details.
datasets.role: The plus/pre-plus axis, and the only inter-rater data we have
datasets.note: Ships as 68 per-patient RAR5 archives. p7zip cannot decode RAR5 and will silently write zero-byte files - use `unar`.
datasets.caveat: ZERO of its 1,533 images are graded unanimously. Every image has 2 or 3 distinct grades among the 5 graders, and the split is systematic (C and E consistently more conservative). Treat as soft labels, never as ground truth.

datasets.title: Multi-View ROP
datasets.labels: Per-image ICROP stage (1-4, A-ROP, Normal) + 6 acquisition views (L/R x temporal/posterior-pole/nasal) + neonatal risk factors (oxygen therapy, ventilation, sepsis, transfusion).
datasets.role: The only source with acquisition-view labels - directly attacks the view confound
datasets.note: Discoverable ONLY via HuggingFace full-text search; absent from Kaggle, figshare and ordinary web search.
datasets.caveat: NON-COMMERCIAL licence - do not mirror publicly. Its zone/plus/treatment columns are nearly empty (zone 13 of 232 patients, plus 17, treatment 14); only the per-image stage labels are complete.

datasets.title: Shenzhen ROP (Zhao 2024)
datasets.labels: Normal, Stage 1-3, laser scars. zip information.xlsx maps image -> infant -> eye.
datasets.role: FIRST DATASET DOWNLOADED in this effort - the original external-validation target
datasets.note: All 512x512. Largely superseded by ROP-VL (same hospital, higher resolution), but 98% of its images are NOT in ROP-VL, so it still contributes.
datasets.caveat: 3 images are filed under two different stage folders at once. Binary labels are unaffected; staging labels contradict for those 3.

datasets.title: HVDROPDB
datasets.region: H.V. Desai Eye Hospital, Pune, India
datasets.labels: Binary ROP/Normal classification, plus segmentation masks for RIDGE (demarcation line), blood vessels and optic disc. RetCam and Neo cameras.
datasets.role: The ridge masks - the feature that defines ICROP stages 1 and 2
datasets.note: 785 files but only 329 UNIQUE fundus images: 21 classification files are byte duplicates and 97 images appear in both the classification and segmentation subsets.
datasets.caveat: Every file is named 1.png..50.png, so basenames collide across all 16 folders. Never flatten this directory.

datasets.title: ROP optic disc segmentation (Shantou)
datasets.labels: Optic disc segmentation, LabelMe JSON per image.
datasets.note: UUID.N filenames, same convention as Multi-View and FARFUM.

datasets.title: ROP retinal vessel segmentation (Shantou)
datasets.labels: Retinal blood vessel segmentation: image + LabelMe JSON + binary mask.
datasets.role: Segmentation only - vessel tortuosity is the substrate of plus disease
datasets.note: Companion release to shantou_od, same authors and date.

datasets.title: ORVS + ROP vessel segmentation
datasets.labels: Vessel segmentation image/label pairs, ROP V1 and V2 plus the adult ORVS set.
datasets.note: V1 and V2 are two mask revisions of one image set.
datasets.caveat: Licence is not stated anywhere - do not redistribute.

datasets.title: ROP stages (reviewed) sample
datasets.labels: Stage 1-3 and NoROP encoded in the filename, with a patient number.
datasets.note: Folder is literally named NewROPDataset_Sample_justtotry - it is a sample, not a release.
datasets.caveat: Provenance and licence both unknown. Do not train on this.

datasets.title: COph100
datasets.labels: Registration control points (LabelMe JSON) + vessel masks + overlays.
datasets.role: ANNOTATIONS ONLY - adds no new photographs
datasets.note: Ships masks and overlays keyed to Ostrava filenames, which we already hold. Its filenames preserve the TRUE Ostrava DG codes.
datasets.caveat: Do not count these as additional images.

datasets.title: Redundant re-uploads (quarantined)
datasets.note: littlevision (Kaggle hemanathrvh13996/rop-dataset-for-little-vision) re-ships Ostrava byte-identically AND FARFUM re-encoded (all 1,533 filenames match). Kept only so nobody re-downloads it to find out.
datasets.caveat: Its folder names contain medical record numbers and exam dates.
